```{r Low Ground Point Audit}
##### Define Helper To Read Point Classification Summary From One LAS/LAZ #####
# Read one classified LAS/LAZ tile and summarize whether class 2 (ground)
# is present and how abundant it is.
#
# IMPORTANT:
# This version includes a read timeout so a bad tile does not hang the QA run.

summarize_classification_counts <- function(single_las_path,
                                            read_timeout_seconds = 60) {

  single_header <- try(lidR::readLASheader(single_las_path), silent = TRUE)

  if (inherits(single_header, "try-error")) {
    return(data.table(
      file_path = single_las_path,
      file_base = basename(single_las_path),
      header_ok = FALSE,
      total_points_header = NA_real_,
      xmin = NA_real_,
      xmax = NA_real_,
      ymin = NA_real_,
      ymax = NA_real_,
      total_points_read = NA_real_,
      ground_n = NA_real_,
      nonground_n = NA_real_,
      ground_prop = NA_real_,
      class_table_text = NA_character_,
      read_ok = FALSE,
      read_status = "header_failed"
    ))
  }

  single_las <- tryCatch({

    setTimeLimit(elapsed = read_timeout_seconds, transient = TRUE)
    on.exit(setTimeLimit(cpu = Inf, elapsed = Inf, transient = FALSE), add = TRUE)

    lidR::readLAS(single_las_path)

  }, error = function(e) {
    return(structure(
      list(message = conditionMessage(e)),
      class = "qa_read_error"
    ))
  })

  if (inherits(single_las, "qa_read_error")) {
    return(data.table(
      file_path = single_las_path,
      file_base = basename(single_las_path),
      header_ok = TRUE,
      total_points_header = single_header@PHB[["Number of point records"]],
      xmin = single_header@PHB[["Min X"]],
      xmax = single_header@PHB[["Max X"]],
      ymin = single_header@PHB[["Min Y"]],
      ymax = single_header@PHB[["Max Y"]],
      total_points_read = NA_real_,
      ground_n = NA_real_,
      nonground_n = NA_real_,
      ground_prop = NA_real_,
      class_table_text = single_las$message,
      read_ok = FALSE,
      read_status = "read_failed_or_timed_out"
    ))
  }

  if (is.null(single_las) || lidR::is.empty(single_las)) {
    return(data.table(
      file_path = single_las_path,
      file_base = basename(single_las_path),
      header_ok = TRUE,
      total_points_header = single_header@PHB[["Number of point records"]],
      xmin = single_header@PHB[["Min X"]],
      xmax = single_header@PHB[["Max X"]],
      ymin = single_header@PHB[["Min Y"]],
      ymax = single_header@PHB[["Max Y"]],
      total_points_read = NA_real_,
      ground_n = NA_real_,
      nonground_n = NA_real_,
      ground_prop = NA_real_,
      class_table_text = NA_character_,
      read_ok = FALSE,
      read_status = "empty_or_null"
    ))
  }

  single_class_table <- table(single_las$Classification, useNA = "ifany")

  single_ground_n <- if ("2" %in% names(single_class_table)) {
    as.numeric(single_class_table[["2"]])
  } else {
    0
  }

  single_total_points <- lidR::npoints(single_las)
  single_nonground_n <- single_total_points - single_ground_n
  single_ground_prop <- if (single_total_points > 0) single_ground_n / single_total_points else NA_real_

  data.table(
    file_path = single_las_path,
    file_base = basename(single_las_path),
    header_ok = TRUE,
    total_points_header = single_header@PHB[["Number of point records"]],
    xmin = single_header@PHB[["Min X"]],
    xmax = single_header@PHB[["Max X"]],
    ymin = single_header@PHB[["Min Y"]],
    ymax = single_header@PHB[["Max Y"]],
    total_points_read = single_total_points,
    ground_n = single_ground_n,
    nonground_n = single_nonground_n,
    ground_prop = single_ground_prop,
    class_table_text = paste(
      paste(names(single_class_table), as.integer(single_class_table), sep = ":"),
      collapse = " | "
    ),
    read_ok = TRUE,
    read_status = "ok"
  )
}

##### Define Helper To Audit One Study Area Ground Output Folder #####
# Build a QA table for all classified tiles in one study area.
#
# FLAGS CREATED:
# - unreadable_or_empty
# - no_ground_points
# - extremely_low_ground
#
# IMPORTANT:
# - prints progress so long runs do not look stalled
# - times each file
# - skips tiles that fail or hang during readLAS()

audit_ground_classification_outputs <- function(ground_directory_path,
                                                filtered_directory_path,
                                                study_area_name,
                                                low_ground_prop_threshold = 0.001,
                                                read_timeout_seconds = 60,
                                                progress_interval = 10) {

  classified_output_paths <- list.files(
    ground_directory_path,
    pattern = "\\.(las|laz)$",
    full.names = TRUE,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )

  filtered_input_paths <- list.files(
    filtered_directory_path,
    pattern = "\\.(las|laz)$",
    full.names = TRUE,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )

  if (length(classified_output_paths) == 0) {
    stop("No classified outputs found in: ", ground_directory_path)
  }

  cat(
    format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
    " - Starting ground QA for ",
    study_area_name,
    " with ",
    length(classified_output_paths),
    " classified tiles.\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  classification_summary_list <- vector("list", length(classified_output_paths))

  for (file_index in seq_along(classified_output_paths)) {

    single_output_path <- classified_output_paths[file_index]

    should_print_progress <- (
      file_index == 1L ||
      file_index == length(classified_output_paths) ||
      (file_index %% progress_interval) == 0L
    )

    if (should_print_progress) {
      cat(
        format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
        " - ",
        study_area_name,
        " QA progress: ",
        file_index,
        " / ",
        length(classified_output_paths),
        " - ",
        basename(single_output_path),
        "\n",
        sep = ""
      )
    }

    single_elapsed_time <- system.time({
      classification_summary_list[[file_index]] <- summarize_classification_counts(
        single_las_path = single_output_path,
        read_timeout_seconds = read_timeout_seconds
      )
    })

    classification_summary_list[[file_index]][
      ,
      elapsed_seconds := as.numeric(single_elapsed_time["elapsed"])
    ]

    single_result <- classification_summary_list[[file_index]]

    single_unreadable_or_empty <- !single_result$header_ok ||
      !single_result$read_ok ||
      is.na(single_result$total_points_read) ||
      single_result$total_points_read == 0

    single_no_ground <- !single_unreadable_or_empty && single_result$ground_n == 0

    single_extremely_low_ground <- !single_unreadable_or_empty &&
      !is.na(single_result$ground_prop) &&
      single_result$ground_prop < low_ground_prop_threshold

    if (single_unreadable_or_empty || single_no_ground || single_extremely_low_ground) {
      cat(
        format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
        " - FLAGGED ",
        study_area_name,
        " tile: ",
        basename(single_output_path),
        " | read_status=",
        single_result$read_status,
        " | elapsed_seconds=",
        round(single_result$elapsed_seconds, 2),
        " | ground_n=",
        ifelse(is.na(single_result$ground_n), "NA", single_result$ground_n),
        " | ground_prop=",
        ifelse(is.na(single_result$ground_prop), "NA", round(single_result$ground_prop, 6)),
        "\n",
        sep = ""
      )
    }
  }

  classification_summary_table <- rbindlist(
    classification_summary_list,
    fill = TRUE
  )

  classification_summary_table[
    ,
    filtered_stem_from_csf := sub(
      "_csf$",
      "",
      tools::file_path_sans_ext(file_base),
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  ]

  filtered_lookup_table <- data.table(
    filtered_path = filtered_input_paths,
    filtered_base = basename(filtered_input_paths)
  )

  filtered_lookup_table[
    ,
    filtered_stem := tools::file_path_sans_ext(filtered_base)
  ]

  classification_summary_table <- merge(
    classification_summary_table,
    filtered_lookup_table[
      ,
      .(filtered_path, filtered_base, filtered_stem)
    ],
    by.x = "filtered_stem_from_csf",
    by.y = "filtered_stem",
    all.x = TRUE
  )

  classification_summary_table[
    ,
    unreadable_or_empty := !header_ok | !read_ok | is.na(total_points_read) | total_points_read == 0
  ]

  classification_summary_table[
    ,
    no_ground_points := !unreadable_or_empty & ground_n == 0
  ]

  classification_summary_table[
    ,
    extremely_low_ground := !unreadable_or_empty &
      !is.na(ground_prop) &
      ground_prop < low_ground_prop_threshold
  ]

  classification_summary_table[
    ,
    qa_flag := fifelse(
      unreadable_or_empty,
      "unreadable_or_empty",
      fifelse(
        no_ground_points,
        "no_ground_points",
        fifelse(
          extremely_low_ground,
          "extremely_low_ground",
          "ok"
        )
      )
    )
  ]

  classification_summary_table[
    ,
    study_area_name := study_area_name
  ]

  cat(
    format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
    " - Finished ground QA for ",
    study_area_name,
    ".\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  classification_summary_table[]
}

Overall, all tiles have ground points and do not seem strange in terms of an over or under amount of ground points. There are two main things though:
1. We will want to get rid of NorthWestElko_2020_D20_11TQG260890_265_filtered_csf as the area is covered more sufficiently by the SouthernID_2018_D19_11TQG260890
2. There are many duplicates/triplicates and we will want to remove them if they are covered by 1 tile with the following logic:
  - Same full tile name and exact same extent
    - flag for manual review to help decide which to keep
    - compare point counts (ground and vegetation)
  - Different full tile name and exact same extent
    - prefer Elko over SouthernID_2018
    - no Elko, pick one deterministically
  - Not exact same extent but one tile covers all of smaller tile
    - keep the preferred/larger surpassing tile
  - Partial overlap only
    - keep both

##### Define Helper To Read Extent From LAS Header #####
# Read bounding box information safely from a LAS/LAZ header so we can compare spatial extents among duplicate or overlapping classified tiles.

read_extent_from_header_safe <- function(single_file_path) {

  single_header <- try(lidR::readLASheader(single_file_path), silent = TRUE)

  if (inherits(single_header, "try-error")) {
    return(data.table(
      xmin = NA_real_,
      xmax = NA_real_,
      ymin = NA_real_,
      ymax = NA_real_,
      header_ok = FALSE
    ))
  }

  data.table(
    xmin = single_header@PHB[["Min X"]],
    xmax = single_header@PHB[["Max X"]],
    ymin = single_header@PHB[["Min Y"]],
    ymax = single_header@PHB[["Max Y"]],
    header_ok = TRUE
  )
}

##### Define Helper To Compare Bounding Boxes #####
# Compare two tile extents so we can decide whether:
# - they are exact duplicates
# - one nearly covers the other
# - they only partially overlap

calculate_bbox_overlap <- function(xmin1, xmax1, ymin1, ymax1,
                                   xmin2, xmax2, ymin2, ymax2) {

  x_overlap <- max(0, min(xmax1, xmax2) - max(xmin1, xmin2))
  y_overlap <- max(0, min(ymax1, ymax2) - max(ymin1, ymin2))

  overlap_area <- x_overlap * y_overlap

  area1 <- (xmax1 - xmin1) * (ymax1 - ymin1)
  area2 <- (xmax2 - xmin2) * (ymax2 - ymin2)

  smaller_area <- min(area1, area2)
  larger_area  <- max(area1, area2)

  overlap_proportion_smaller <- if (smaller_area > 0) overlap_area / smaller_area else NA_real_
  overlap_proportion_larger  <- if (larger_area > 0) overlap_area / larger_area else NA_real_

  data.table(
    area1 = area1,
    area2 = area2,
    overlap_area = overlap_area,
    overlap_proportion_smaller = overlap_proportion_smaller,
    overlap_proportion_larger = overlap_proportion_larger
  )
}

##### STEP 5) Force Drop Known Tiny Fragment #####
# Remove the specific edge fragment you already identified as not worth keeping because it is covered more completely by another tile.

known_fragment_drop_base_names <- c(
  "USGS_LPC_NV_NorthWestElko_2020_D20_11TQG260890_265_filtered_csf.las"
)

southhills_forced_drop_table <- southhills_classified_inventory_table[
  file_base %in% known_fragment_drop_base_names,
  .(
    file_base,
    csf_output_path,
    short_tile_code,
    source_type,
    total_points_read,
    ground_n,
    vegetation_n,
    drop_reason = "known_tiny_fragment_covered_by_more_complete_tile"
  )
]

cat("\n##### QA STEP 5 SUMMARY #####\n")
cat("Forced-drop known fragments:", nrow(southhills_forced_drop_table), "\n")
print(southhills_forced_drop_table)

##### STEP 6) Subset Duplicate Groups #####
# Keep only files that:
# - share a short tile code with at least one other file
# - are not already force-dropped as known tiny fragments

southhills_duplicate_groups_table <- southhills_classified_inventory_table[
  n_same_tile_code > 1 &
    !file_base %in% known_fragment_drop_base_names
]

cat("\n##### QA STEP 6 SUMMARY #####\n")
cat("Files in duplicate/triplicate groups:", nrow(southhills_duplicate_groups_table), "\n")
cat("Unique duplicated short tile codes:", uniqueN(southhills_duplicate_groups_table$short_tile_code), "\n")

##### STEP 7) Compare All Pairs Within Duplicate Groups #####
# For each short tile code with multiple files:
# - compare same-name vs different-name cases
# - compare exact same extent vs near-complete overlap vs partial overlap
# - apply decision rules
#
# DECISION LOGIC:
# - same full name + same extent = manual review
# - different full name + same extent = keep one, prefer Elko
# - near-complete overlap = keep preferred tile / larger tile
# - partial overlap = keep both

extent_tolerance <- 0.001
near_complete_overlap_threshold <- 0.98

southhills_duplicate_pair_results <- list()

duplicate_tile_codes <- unique(southhills_duplicate_groups_table$short_tile_code)

for (single_tile_code in duplicate_tile_codes) {

  single_group <- southhills_duplicate_groups_table[
    short_tile_code == single_tile_code
  ]

  if (nrow(single_group) < 2) next

  single_pairs <- utils::combn(seq_len(nrow(single_group)), 2)

  for (pair_index in seq_len(ncol(single_pairs))) {

    i <- single_pairs[1, pair_index]
    j <- single_pairs[2, pair_index]

    single_overlap_stats <- calculate_bbox_overlap(
      xmin1 = single_group$xmin[i],
      xmax1 = single_group$xmax[i],
      ymin1 = single_group$ymin[i],
      ymax1 = single_group$ymax[i],
      xmin2 = single_group$xmin[j],
      xmax2 = single_group$xmax[j],
      ymin2 = single_group$ymin[j],
      ymax2 = single_group$ymax[j]
    )

    same_full_tile_name <- single_group$spatial_tile_code_from_csf[i] ==
      single_group$spatial_tile_code_from_csf[j]

    exact_same_extent <- all(
      abs(single_group$xmin[i] - single_group$xmin[j]) <= extent_tolerance,
      abs(single_group$xmax[i] - single_group$xmax[j]) <= extent_tolerance,
      abs(single_group$ymin[i] - single_group$ymin[j]) <= extent_tolerance,
      abs(single_group$ymax[i] - single_group$ymax[j]) <= extent_tolerance
    )

    same_total_points <- isTRUE(all.equal(
      single_group$total_points_read[i],
      single_group$total_points_read[j]
    ))

    same_ground_points <- isTRUE(all.equal(
      single_group$ground_n[i],
      single_group$ground_n[j]
    ))

    same_vegetation_points <- isTRUE(all.equal(
      single_group$vegetation_n[i],
      single_group$vegetation_n[j]
    ))

    area_a <- single_overlap_stats$area1
    area_b <- single_overlap_stats$area2

    preferred_file <- NA_character_
    drop_file <- NA_character_
    decision_reason <- NA_character_
    needs_manual_review <- FALSE

    if (same_full_tile_name && exact_same_extent) {

      needs_manual_review <- TRUE

      if (same_total_points && same_ground_points && same_vegetation_points) {
        decision_reason <- "manual_review_same_name_same_extent_same_counts"
      } else {
        decision_reason <- "manual_review_same_name_same_extent_different_counts"
      }

    } else if (!same_full_tile_name && exact_same_extent) {

      if (single_group$source_rank[i] > single_group$source_rank[j]) {
        preferred_file <- single_group$file_base[i]
        drop_file <- single_group$file_base[j]
        decision_reason <- "drop_same_extent_prefer_elko_or_higher_rank"
      } else if (single_group$source_rank[j] > single_group$source_rank[i]) {
        preferred_file <- single_group$file_base[j]
        drop_file <- single_group$file_base[i]
        decision_reason <- "drop_same_extent_prefer_elko_or_higher_rank"
      } else {
        preferred_file <- min(single_group$file_base[i], single_group$file_base[j])
        drop_file <- max(single_group$file_base[i], single_group$file_base[j])
        decision_reason <- "drop_same_extent_deterministic_same_rank"
      }

    } else if (!is.na(single_overlap_stats$overlap_proportion_smaller) &&
               single_overlap_stats$overlap_proportion_smaller >= near_complete_overlap_threshold) {

      if (single_group$source_rank[i] > single_group$source_rank[j] &&
          area_a >= area_b * 0.98) {
        preferred_file <- single_group$file_base[i]
        drop_file <- single_group$file_base[j]
        decision_reason <- "drop_near_complete_overlap_prefer_elko_or_higher_rank"
      } else if (single_group$source_rank[j] > single_group$source_rank[i] &&
                 area_b >= area_a * 0.98) {
        preferred_file <- single_group$file_base[j]
        drop_file <- single_group$file_base[i]
        decision_reason <- "drop_near_complete_overlap_prefer_elko_or_higher_rank"
      } else if (area_a > area_b) {
        preferred_file <- single_group$file_base[i]
        drop_file <- single_group$file_base[j]
        decision_reason <- "drop_near_complete_overlap_keep_larger_extent"
      } else if (area_b > area_a) {
        preferred_file <- single_group$file_base[j]
        drop_file <- single_group$file_base[i]
        decision_reason <- "drop_near_complete_overlap_keep_larger_extent"
      } else {
        preferred_file <- min(single_group$file_base[i], single_group$file_base[j])
        drop_file <- max(single_group$file_base[i], single_group$file_base[j])
        decision_reason <- "drop_near_complete_overlap_deterministic_same_area"
      }

    } else {

      decision_reason <- "keep_both_partial_overlap"
      needs_manual_review <- FALSE
    }

    southhills_duplicate_pair_results[[length(southhills_duplicate_pair_results) + 1]] <- data.table(
      short_tile_code = single_tile_code,
      file_a = single_group$file_base[i],
      file_b = single_group$file_base[j],
      path_a = single_group$csf_output_path[i],
      path_b = single_group$csf_output_path[j],
      spatial_tile_code_a = single_group$spatial_tile_code_from_csf[i],
      spatial_tile_code_b = single_group$spatial_tile_code_from_csf[j],
      source_type_a = single_group$source_type[i],
      source_type_b = single_group$source_type[j],
      total_points_a = single_group$total_points_read[i],
      total_points_b = single_group$total_points_read[j],
      ground_n_a = single_group$ground_n[i],
      ground_n_b = single_group$ground_n[j],
      vegetation_n_a = single_group$vegetation_n[i],
      vegetation_n_b = single_group$vegetation_n[j],
      area_a = area_a,
      area_b = area_b,
      overlap_area = single_overlap_stats$overlap_area,
      overlap_proportion_smaller = single_overlap_stats$overlap_proportion_smaller,
      overlap_proportion_larger = single_overlap_stats$overlap_proportion_larger,
      same_full_tile_name = same_full_tile_name,
      exact_same_extent = exact_same_extent,
      same_total_points = same_total_points,
      same_ground_points = same_ground_points,
      same_vegetation_points = same_vegetation_points,
      preferred_file = preferred_file,
      drop_file = drop_file,
      decision_reason = decision_reason,
      needs_manual_review = needs_manual_review
    )
  }
}

southhills_duplicate_pair_decision_table <- rbindlist(
  southhills_duplicate_pair_results,
  fill = TRUE
)

cat("\n##### QA STEP 7 SUMMARY #####\n")
cat("Pairwise duplicate comparisons:", nrow(southhills_duplicate_pair_decision_table), "\n")
print(
  southhills_duplicate_pair_decision_table[
    ,
    .N,
    by = decision_reason
  ][order(decision_reason)]
)

##### STEP 8) Save Pairwise Decision Table #####

fwrite(
  southhills_duplicate_pair_decision_table,
  file.path(
    southhills_log_directory,
    "SouthHills_duplicate_pair_decision_table.csv"
  )
)

saveRDS(
  southhills_duplicate_pair_decision_table,
  file.path(
    southhills_log_directory,
    "SouthHills_duplicate_pair_decision_table.rds"
  )
)

##### STEP 9) Build Manual Review Table #####
# PURPOSE:
# Pull out same-name + same-extent cases for human review before deciding
# whether to collapse them to one tile.

southhills_manual_review_table <- southhills_duplicate_pair_decision_table[
  needs_manual_review == TRUE
]

cat("\n##### QA STEP 9 SUMMARY #####\n")
cat("Manual-review duplicate pairs:", nrow(southhills_manual_review_table), "\n")

fwrite(
  southhills_manual_review_table,
  file.path(
    southhills_log_directory,
    "SouthHills_duplicate_manual_review_table.csv"
  )
)

saveRDS(
  southhills_manual_review_table,
  file.path(
    southhills_log_directory,
    "SouthHills_duplicate_manual_review_table.rds"
  )
)

############## STOP PERFORM MANUAL REVIEW ##############

##### STEP 10) Build Automatic Drop Table #####
# PURPOSE:
# Combine:
# - known forced drops
# - safe automatic drops from exact same extent or near-complete overlap
#
# IMPORTANT:
# Manual-review rows are NOT auto-dropped here.

southhills_auto_drop_table <- unique(rbindlist(
  list(
    southhills_forced_drop_table[
      ,
      .(
        file_base,
        csf_output_path,
        short_tile_code,
        drop_reason
      )
    ],
    southhills_duplicate_pair_decision_table[
      !is.na(drop_file) & needs_manual_review == FALSE,
      .(
        file_base = drop_file,
        csf_output_path = fifelse(drop_file == file_a, path_a, path_b),
        short_tile_code,
        drop_reason = decision_reason
      )
    ]
  ),
  fill = TRUE
))

cat("\n##### QA STEP 10 SUMMARY #####\n")
cat("Automatic drop rows:", nrow(southhills_auto_drop_table), "\n")
print(
  southhills_auto_drop_table[
    ,
    .N,
    by = drop_reason
  ][order(drop_reason)]
)

##### STEP 11) Build Automatic Keep Table #####
# PURPOSE:
# Keep everything not in the auto-drop table.
#
# NOTE:
# Manual-review tiles remain in the keep table for now until you make a final
# choice about them.

southhills_all_classified_lookup_table <- unique(
  southhills_classified_inventory_table[
    ,
    .(
      file_base,
      csf_output_path,
      short_tile_code,
      source_type,
      total_points_read,
      ground_n,
      vegetation_n,
      extent_area
    )
  ]
)

southhills_auto_keep_table <- southhills_all_classified_lookup_table[
  !file_base %in% southhills_auto_drop_table$file_base
]

cat("\n##### QA STEP 11 SUMMARY #####\n")
cat("Total classified outputs:", nrow(southhills_all_classified_lookup_table), "\n")
cat("Auto-dropped outputs:", nrow(unique(southhills_auto_drop_table[, .(file_base)])), "\n")
cat("Remaining keep outputs:", nrow(unique(southhills_auto_keep_table[, .(file_base)])), "\n")
cat(
  "Accounting check (keep + drop):",
  nrow(unique(southhills_auto_keep_table[, .(file_base)])) +
    nrow(unique(southhills_auto_drop_table[, .(file_base)])),
  "\n"
)

##### STEP 12) Save Keep / Drop Tables #####

fwrite(
  southhills_auto_drop_table,
  file.path(
    southhills_log_directory,
    "SouthHills_classified_auto_drop_table.csv"
  )
)

saveRDS(
  southhills_auto_drop_table,
  file.path(
    southhills_log_directory,
    "SouthHills_classified_auto_drop_table.rds"
  )
)

fwrite(
  southhills_auto_keep_table,
  file.path(
    southhills_log_directory,
    "SouthHills_classified_auto_keep_table.csv"
  )
)

saveRDS(
  southhills_auto_keep_table,
  file.path(
    southhills_log_directory,
    "SouthHills_classified_auto_keep_table.rds"
  )
)

##### STEP 13) Final QA Prints #####
# PURPOSE:
# Print the key outputs you are most likely to review by eye.

cat("\n##### FINAL QA SUMMARY #####\n")
cat("Total South Hills classified outputs:", nrow(southhills_all_classified_lookup_table), "\n")
cat("Forced-drop fragments:", nrow(southhills_forced_drop_table), "\n")
cat("Auto-drop duplicate outputs:", nrow(unique(southhills_auto_drop_table[, .(file_base)])), "\n")
cat("Manual-review duplicate pairs:", nrow(southhills_manual_review_table), "\n")
cat("Final keep outputs after auto-drop:", nrow(unique(southhills_auto_keep_table[, .(file_base)])), "\n")

cat("\n##### AUTO DROP TABLE #####\n")
print(
  southhills_auto_drop_table[
    order(short_tile_code, file_base)
  ]
)

cat("\n##### MANUAL REVIEW TABLE #####\n")
print(
  southhills_manual_review_table[
    order(short_tile_code, file_a, file_b),
    .(
      short_tile_code,
      file_a,
      file_b,
      same_full_tile_name,
      exact_same_extent,
      same_total_points,
      same_ground_points,
      same_vegetation_points,
      decision_reason
    )
  ]
)
```
